narrative: 白天已经过去，但天空仍然能充当一层光的包裹。城市把钴蓝色的空气，与钠灯、钨丝灯和霓虹灯混在一起。
犯罪片和忧郁基调的外景戏常用这种混合，因为脸可以是冷的，而窗户可以是暖的。如果你仍然想要一轮阳光擦过地面，它就不是合适的工具。
那是黄金时刻（Golden Hour）或傍晚残阳。在纯黑的夜景上加一个蓝色调色，并不等于蓝调时刻。
你需要的是残留的天光亮度。
how: 为那片依然发光的天空曝光，把它当作一个巨大、柔和、由上方或侧方投下的光源，色温偏高偏冷。再加入暖色的实景光源（Practical Lighting）（路灯、窗户、招牌）作为小面积的硬光或半硬光点缀。
包裹光的硬度是软的；灯具本身的硬度则各不相同。重点在于色彩对比：冷调的环境光对上暖调的灯具。
提示词：Blue hour wrap on [Subject], deep cobalt sky still glowing, warm practicals kicking in.
when: 当太阳已经落下但天空仍然透亮时使用——城市街道、站台、屋顶。不要用它来拍一个硬朗的日落逆光。
vs: 黄金时刻仍然有方向性的暖色阳光。霓虹实景光（Neon Practicals）常常出现在蓝调时刻内部，作为暖色或洋红色的点缀。
此时的现场光（Available Light），如果你不额外添加任何东西，正是这种混合光。冷蓝色调是一种调色手法；蓝调时刻是真实的天光条件。
动机光可以用大面积的冷色顶光加暖色灯具来伪造出这种效果。
examples_film: 《盗火线》（Heat）和《借刀杀人》（Collateral）都建立在洛杉矶暮色之上——数字摄影友好的钴蓝色空气，混合钠灯与钨丝灯光。《亡命驾驶》（Drive）用了同样的城市混合光：残留天光加招牌。
天空必须还在那里发光。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是拍成了黄金时刻，或纯黑的夜景夜拍。破绽是长长的暖色阳光投影，或者一片毫无光亮的天空。
解决办法是去掉太阳，让包裹光变冷，并在仍然透亮的天空下打开各种实景光源。

faq.q: 电影中的蓝调时刻是什么？
faq.a: 日出前或日落后的冷色暮光，太阳已落下，天空依然透亮。暖色的实景光源常常与这种冷色包裹光形成对比。

faq.q: 蓝调时刻和黄金时刻有什么区别？
faq.a: 蓝调时刻没有硬朗的阳光，天空是冷色的。黄金时刻的太阳还挂在地平线附近，是一个投下长影的暖色方向性光源。

faq.q: 什么时候该用蓝调时刻？
faq.a: 适合城市或户外的黄昏戏，此时天空仍然有作用，灯具正逐一亮起。如果需要擦地而过的阳光，就不要用它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示蓝调时刻？
faq.a: 指明天空是深邃的钴蓝色、依然发光，没有太阳轮廓，暖色实景光源正在亮起。柔和的冷色包裹光加小面积暖色灯具。

narrative: Day is gone but the sky still works as a wrap. Cities mix cobalt air with sodium, tungsten, and neon.
Crime and melancholy exteriors use this mix because faces can be cool while windows go warm. It is the wrong tool if you still want a sun disk raking the ground.
That is golden hour or late sun. A blue grade on night black is not blue hour.
how: Expose for the glowing sky as a large, soft, overhead-to-side source, Kelvin high and cool. Add warm practicals (streetlights, windows, signs) as small hard or semi-hard accents.
Hardness of the wrap is soft; hardness of the lamps is whatever they are. Color contrast is the point: cool ambient versus warm fixtures.
Prompt: Blue hour wrap on [Subject], deep cobalt sky still glowing, warm practicals kicking in.
when: Use it when the sun is down but the sky still holds, a city street, a platform, a rooftop. Do not use it for a hard sunset backlight.
vs: Golden hour still has directional warm sun. Neon practicals often appear inside blue hour as the warm or magenta notes.
Available light at this time is exactly this mix if you add nothing. Cool blue is a grade; blue hour is a real sky condition.
Motivated lighting can fake it with large cool overheads plus warm lamps.
examples_film: Heat and Collateral are built on Los Angeles twilight, digital-friendly cobalt air with sodium and tungsten. Drive uses the same urban mix of residual sky and signs.
The sky has to still be there.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is golden hour or night-for-night black. The tell is long warm sun shadows, or a sky with no glow.
Fix it by killing the sun, cooling the wrap, and turning practicals on against a still-bright sky.

faq.q: What is blue hour in film?
faq.a: Cool twilight before sunrise or after sunset, with the sun down and the sky still glowing. Warm practicals often contrast with that cool wrap.
Blue hour has no hard sun and a cool sky. Golden hour has the sun just above the horizon as a warm directional source with long shadows.

faq.q: When should I use blue hour?
faq.a: Use it for urban or exterior twilight when the sky still works and lamps are coming on. Skip it if you need raking sun.

faq.q: How do I prompt blue hour for AI image or video?
faq.a: Specify a deep cobalt sky still glowing, no sun disk, warm practicals kicking in. Soft cool wrap plus small warm fixtures.
